(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.bsa-svg').dataset;if(Number(d.bsaArea)<=Number(window.bsaBase.bsaArea))throw Error('Input has no effect on opening');if([...document.querySelectorAll('[data-bsa-kind] path')].map(n=>n.getAttribute('d')).join('|')===window.bsaBasePaths)throw Error('Actual opening paths did not move');if(document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!==document.querySelector('[data-anatomy-result]').textContent)throw Error('Results diverged');return 'Input 1 changes numeric result and aperture';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.bsa-svg').dataset;if(Number(d.bsaArea)<=Number(window.bsaBase.bsaArea))throw Error('Input has no effect on opening');if([...document.querySelectorAll('[data-bsa-kind] path')].map(n=>n.getAttribute('d')).join('|')===window.bsaBasePaths)throw Error('Actual opening paths did not move');if(document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!==document.querySelector('[data-anatomy-result]').textContent)throw Error('Results diverged');return 'Input 2 changes numeric result and aperture';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.bsa-svg').dataset;if(Math.abs(Number(d.bsaW)-Number(d.bsaH))>1e-6)throw Error('Not square');if(Math.abs(Number(d.bsaW)*Number(d.bsaH)-Number(window.bsaBase.bsaW)*Number(window.bsaBase.bsaH))>1e-4)throw Error('Area changed');if(Math.abs(Number(d.bsaResult)-Number(window.bsaBase.bsaResult))>1e-6)throw Error('Form changed medical result');return 'Square preserves area and KOF';})()
